blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We introduce CoDeR , a new paradigm for world modeling. Unlike existing video world models that implicitly represent world dynamics through visual observations, our system explicitly constructs an executable world with code and employs video generation models for visual realization. Specifically, we coordinate five complementary roles to translate high-level concepts into structured world rules, executable dynamics, and perceptual observations. This design enables long-term memory , open-ended interactions , autonomous world evolution , and multi-agent scenarios , where multiple entities can act, interact, and evolve persistently beyond the current observation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially extends the capabilities of existing world models, enabling long-term memory, open-ended interactions, autonomous evolution, and persistent multi-agent dynamics, while achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple evaluation settings. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.
Project Page: CoDeR .
blocks.zh:
我们介绍CoDER, 一个世界建模的新范例。 与通过视觉观测隐含代表世界动态的现有视频世界模型不同,我们的系统明确构建了一个带有代码的可执行世界,并使用视频生成模型进行视觉实现. 具体而言,我们协调了五个互补作用,将高级别概念转化为结构化的世界规则、可执行的动态和概念观察。 这种设计可以实现长期记忆、开放式互动、自主世界演变和多代理方案,其中多个实体可以采取行动、互动,并持续地演化,超越目前的观察。 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架大大扩展了现有世界模型的能力,能够进行长期记忆、开放式互动、自主进化和持续的多代理动态,同时在多个评价环境中实现最新业绩。 代码和模型权重将公布于众。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World modeling aims to simulate interactive environments that evolve in response to agents’ actions, with applications in embodied AI ( NVIDIA et al., 2026 ; Bar et al., 2025 ) , video games ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ) , and virtual reality ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . Many recent approaches build on video generation models to synthesize visually compelling observations ( Yu et al., 2025d ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , incorporating control signals ( Yu et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2025b ; Mao et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2025 ) such as camera poses to enable interaction ( He et al., 2025a ) . However, these approaches often encode world state implicitly in visual histories, which can make it difficult to maintain persistent memory, model off-screen dynamics, and enforce consistent object interactions ( Ma et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2025a ) . Moreover, visual observations reveal only part of a world: underlying states, rules, and relationships—such as resource ownership, physical constraints, and social connections ( Park et al., 2023 ) —can shape future events without being directly visible.
blocks.zh: 世界建模旨在模拟因物剂行为而演变的互动环境,其应用体现为AI(NVIDIA等人,2026年;Bar等人,2025年),电子游戏(Guo等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年;Alonso等人,2024年),虚拟现实(Yang等人,2024年b;Xie等人,2026年). 许多最近的方法基于视频生成模型,以合成可视化的观测结果(Yu等人,2025d;Huang等人,2026a;Yang等人,2026;Zhou等人,2026),包含控制信号(Yu等人,2025c;Li等人,2025b;Mao等人,2025b;Feng等人,2025a),如相机姿势,以便能够相互作用(He等人,2025a)。 然而,这些方法往往在视觉历史中隐含地编码世界状态,从而可能难以保持持续记忆、模拟屏幕外动态以及执行一致的物体相互作用(Ma等人,2026b;Li等人,2025a)。 此外,视觉观察只揭示了世界的一部分:基本状态、规则和关系——例如资源所有权、物理限制和社会联系(Park等人,2023年)——能够塑造未来事件而不直接可见。

blocks.en: A coherent world should evolve according to well-defined rules, even when it is not being observed. This principle reflects everyday experience: water placed in a functioning freezer continues to cool and eventually freezes. Its evolution depends on physical conditions, rather than its visibility to an observer. This motivates a world representation that maintains persistent state ( Garcin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) and governs its evolution independently of visual observation. Meanwhile, recent large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable world knowledge and robust reasoning capabilities, offering a promising route toward this goal: translating a world into executable rules and state transitions ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Piriyakulkij et al., 2025 ) . Such a formulation enables the maintenance of the underlying world representation, while a video generation model synthesizes temporary visual observations on top of the structured world ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个连贯的世界应当按照明确界定的规则发展,即使没有得到遵守。 这一原则反映了日常经验:放置在功能性冷冻器中的水继续冷却并最终冷冻. 其演变取决于物理条件,而不是对观察者的能见度. 这激发了保持持续状态的世界代表性(Garcin等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b),并独立于视觉观察来管理其演变. 与此同时,最近的大型语言模型展现出卓越的世界知识和强大的推理能力,为实现这一目标提供了一条有希望的道路:将世界转化为可执行的规则和国家过渡(Tang等人,2024年;Piriyakulkij等人,2025年)。 这种配方能够维持基本的世界代表性,而视频生成模型则合成结构世界之上的临时视觉观测(Zhan等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Realizing this vision requires more than generating executable scene code. A complete world comprises heterogeneous systems, such as transportation, construction, and resource management, each governed by local mechanisms while remaining subject to shared constraints. Constructing these systems therefore requires a way to decompose the world into manageable components and coordinate their interactions. Equally important is the connection between executable state and visual observation: abstract rules and state transitions must be translated into spatial and temporal conditions that a video generation model can follow ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . These challenges call for a framework that organizes world construction and connects its execution to visual synthesis.
blocks.zh: 实现这一愿景不仅需要生成可执行的场景代码。 一个完整的世界包括不同的系统,如运输、建筑和资源管理,每个系统都受当地机制的制约,但仍受到共同的限制。 因此,构建这些系统需要一种将世界分解为可管理的组成部分和协调其相互作用的方法。 同样重要的是可执行状态和视觉观察之间的联系:抽象规则和状态过渡必须转化为视频生成模型可以遵循的时空条件(Chen等人,2026a). 这些挑战要求有一个框架来组织世界建筑并将其执行与视觉合成联系起来.

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce CoDeR, a framework organized around five complementary roles: the God of Concepts, the Creator, Executors, Artists, and Travelers. Specifically, the God of Concepts expresses the desired world through language or images. The Creator, instantiated as a large language model, interprets this intent, elaborates shared rules and a thematic direction, and produces a world design blueprint. Executors, a group of coding agents, translate the blueprint into executable entities, behaviors, and systems. Artists, implemented as video generation models, transform visual conditions derived from this executable world into detailed artistic realizations. Finally, Travelers explore the environment and experience its unfolding events from their own perspectives. Together with our proposed Logical Spaces strategy and Observation as World Registration paradigm, CoDeR achieves consistent world generation, open-ended interactions, dynamic evolution and multi-agent collaboration.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了CoDeR,这是一个围绕五个互补角色组成的框架:概念之神、创造者、执行者、艺术家和旅行者。 具体来说,概念之神通过语言或图像来表达期望的世界. "创造者"(The Creator),即时化为大型语言模型,诠释了这一意图,详细制定了共享规则和主题方向,并制作了世界设计蓝图. 执行者,一组编码代理,将蓝图翻译为可执行的实体,行为,和系统. 艺术家作为视频生成模型实施,将这个可执行的世界衍生出来的视觉条件转化为详细的艺术实现. 最后,旅行者从自己的角度探索环境并体验其正在发生的事件。 连同我们提议的作为世界登记范式的逻辑空间战略和观测,CoDER实现了一致的世界生成、开放式互动、动态演变和多代理协作。

blocks.en: 2.2 World Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 世界建模

blocks.en: Beyond passive video synthesis, world models aim to simulate an environment as a persistent process whose state changes in response to actions, events, and the passage of time. Recent advances in generative modeling ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Bahmani et al., 2026 ) have substantially improved the visual fidelity of such simulated worlds ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , while progressively extending them toward interactive, persistent, and autonomous environments.
blocks.zh: 除了被动视频合成外,世界模型还旨在模拟一种环境,将其作为一个持续的过程,其状态变化是对行动、事件和时间流逝的反应。 遗传模型方面的最新进展(Yu等人,2025年a); Huang等人,2026b;Bahmani等人,2026)大大改善了这种模拟世界的视觉真实性(Huang等人,2025b;Chen等人,2025a),同时逐步将其扩展到互动、持久和自主的环境。

blocks.en: Interactivity. A fundamental capability of world models is to respond to actions ( Tong et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Tang et al., 2026 ) rather than merely generate a predetermined visual trajectory. Early works such as Genie Bruce et al. (2024) learn action-controllable environments from large-scale videos, while GameNGen Valevski et al. (2025) demonstrates that a diffusion model can directly serve as a real-time neural game engine. Subsequent approaches, including GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) , Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) , and its real-time extensions ( He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026e ) , further improve action controllability, visual quality, and streaming efficiency ( Sun et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, the action spaces of many existing world models remain dominated by navigation or predefined control signals. Recent methods such as ActWorld Xiong et al. (2026) begin to support richer mid-rollout object interactions, highlighting the transition from merely explorable environments toward genuinely interactive worlds ( Gao et al., 2026b ; Mao et al., 2025a ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 互动。 世界模型的一个基本能力是对行动作出反应(Tong等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年a; Tang et al., 2026 ) , 而不是仅仅产生一个预定的视觉轨迹. 早期的作品如Genie Bruce等. (2024)从大型视频中学习动作可控环境,而GameNgen Valevski et al. (2025年)证明扩散模型可以直接作为实时神经游戏引擎. 后续方法,包括GameGen-X Che等人(2025年)、Matrix-Game Zhang等人(2025年)及其实时扩展(He等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2026年e),进一步提高动作可控性、视觉质量和流速效率(Sun等人,2026年b;Xu等人,2026年a; Q等,2026). 尽管如此,许多现有世界模型的动作空间仍然以导航或预定义的控制信号为主. ActWorld Xiong等人(2026年)等近期方法开始支持更丰富的中间推出对象互动,强调从单纯的可探索环境向真正互动世界的过渡(Gao等人,2026b;Mao等人,2025a;DreamX). Team等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Memory. Long-term interaction further requires a world to preserve information beyond the immediate generation context ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026a ) . This includes not only temporal continuity, but also persistent object identities, spatial layouts ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026f ) , and the consequences of previous interactions when a location is revisited. Recent world models therefore increasingly incorporate explicit long-horizon memory mechanisms ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Ren et al., 2025 ) . RELIC Hong et al. (2025) , for example, compresses historical observations into camera-aware latent memories for real-time long-duration exploration. Related approaches such as AlayaWorld AlayaWorld Team et al. (2026) integrate compressed history and geometry-aware spatial memories to stabilize long autoregressive rollouts. These efforts substantially extend the effective temporal horizon of video world models ( Yu et al., 2026a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) ; however, such memory is primarily designed to reconstruct or retrieve previously observed states ( Li et al., 2025c ; Yu et al., 2025b ) , rather than to explicitly model how the underlying world itself changes over time.
blocks.zh: 记忆. 长期互动进一步要求世界保存超越即时生成背景的信息(Huang等人,2025a); Chen等人,2025b;Shen等人,2026;Ma等人,2026a). 这不仅包括时间连续性,还包括持续的物体特征,空间布局(Wu等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026年b;Wang等人,2026年f),以及重新审视一个位置时以往相互作用的后果. 因此,最近的世界模型越来越多地纳入明确的长视距记忆机制(萧等人,2025年;赵等人,2026年a;Ren等人,2025年)。 记录 例如,Hong等人(2025年)将历史观测压缩成摄像头-意识潜伏记忆,用于实时的长期探索. AlayaWorld Alaya World Team et al. (2026)等相关方法整合了压缩历史和几何感知空间记忆,以稳定长期自旋式推出. 这些努力大大扩展了视频世界模型的有效时间范围(Yu等人,2026年a;Oshima等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年c),然而,这种记忆主要是为了重建或检索以前观测到的状态(Li等人,2025年c;Yu等人,2025年b),而不是明确模拟基本世界本身如何随时间演变。

blocks.en: Evolution. A persistent world should not only remember its past, but also continue to evolve independently of the observer. This distinction exposes a fundamental limitation of observation-centric video world models: when an entity leaves the camera view, its internal state may effectively stop evolving until it becomes visible again. Recent studies explicitly identify this out-of-sight dynamics problem. LiveWorld Duan et al. (2026) addresses this problem by separating observation rendering from a persistent global state, allowing dynamic entities to continue evolving while they are outside the current field of view. ReMind Xu et al. (2026b) further trains video generators to retrieve and propagate hidden dynamic states across observation gaps. These approaches move world modeling beyond static spatial memory toward persistent temporal processes ( Lillemark et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Nevertheless, supporting open-ended evolution—where independent entities, events, and processes can autonomously alter the world over arbitrarily long timescales—remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 进化 一个持久的世界不仅应该记住它的过去,而且应该独立于观察者而继续演变。 这种区分暴露了以观测为中心的视频世界模型的根本局限性:当一个实体离开镜头视图时,其内部状态可能会有效停止演化,直到再次显眼. 最近的研究明确确定了这一视线外动态问题。 LiveWorld Duan等人(2026年)通过将观察渲染与持续的全球状态区分开来解决这一问题,允许动态实体在处于当前视野之外时继续演变. ReMind Xu等人(2026年b)进一步培训视频生成器,以检索和传播跨越观测差距的隐藏动态状态。 这些方法将超越静态空间记忆的世界模型转移到持续的时间过程(Lillemark等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年b ). 然而,支持无限制的演进,即独立实体、事件和进程可以任意地在很长的时间范围内自主地改变世界,仍然基本上没有得到探讨。

blocks.en: Beyond Vision. More fundamentally, a world is not merely a sequence of visual observations. Pixels describe how a world appears , but do not explicitly represent the concepts, rules, relations, and causal mechanisms that determine how it operates. This has motivated recent efforts to augment neural world models with structured and executable representations ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Piriyakulkij et al., 2025 ) . Agent World Model Wang et al. (2026d) constructs code-driven, database-backed environments for training interactive agents, providing explicit and reliable state transitions beyond natural-language simulation. Collectively, these works suggest a transition from purely visual world models toward hybrid systems in which structured representations govern world logic and generative models realize perceptual observations ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . Our CoDeR follows this direction while further organizing world construction and evolution through multiple specialized agents, enabling world logic, autonomous processes, and visual realization to evolve collaboratively rather than being represented by a single monolithic visual dynamics model.
blocks.zh: 超越视野。 更根本的是,一个世界不仅仅是一系列视觉观察。 像素描述一个世界是如何出现的,但没有明确代表决定它如何运作的概念,规则,关系和因果机制. 这促使最近努力以结构化和可执行的表示方式增强神经世界模型(Tang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026a年;Piriyakulkij等人,2025年)。 代理世界模式 Wang et al. (2026d)构建了代码驱动,数据库支撑的环境,用于培训互动代理,提供超越自然语言模拟的清晰可靠的状态过渡. 这些著作集体地表明,从纯粹的视觉世界模型向混合系统过渡,其中结构化的表述支配世界逻辑和基因模型实现知觉观察(Cai等人,2026年;Meng等人,2026年)。 我们的CoDeR遵循这个方向,同时通过多种专业代理进一步组织世界的构建和进化,使世界逻辑,自主过程,视觉实现能够协同发展,而不是被单一的视觉动态模型所代表.

blocks.en: 3 CoDeR
blocks.zh: 3个CoDER

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: This section presents the pipeline of our proposed CoDeR. We begin by elaborating on the functionalities of the roles introduced within the system, followed by an illustration of how these roles interact and collaborate to construct an interactive and continuously evolving world model.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们拟议的CoDER的管道。 我们首先阐述系统内引入的作用的功能,然后说明这些作用如何相互作用和协作,以构建一个互动和不断演变的世界模式。

blocks.en:
The God of Concepts. “Let there be light!” said the God.
In our world system, the God of Concepts serves as the ultimate origin of the world to be created. In practice, this role can freely describe the desired world through text or images, in a manner similar to how prior works directly prompt video generation models ( Che et al., 2025 ) . However, unlike the prevalent paradigm in current world modeling, where a text encoder or prompt enhancer processes this intent before feeding it directly into a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , our system applies only minimal modification ( e.g. , format alignment) to the input—motivated by our belief that a world is inherently difficult to describe using only one or a few sentences—and instead forwards this intent to the next node, the Creator.
blocks.zh:
概念之神. 上帝说,“让光明存在!”
在我们的世界体系中,概念之神是世界的最终起源。 在实践中,这个角色可以通过文字或图像自由描述期望的世界,其方式类似于前作如何直接促进视频生成模型(Che等人,2025年). 然而,与当前世界建模中流行的范式不同,一个文本编码器或即时增强器在直接输入到一个DiT(Difmusion Transformer)(Peebles and Xie, 2023)之前会处理这个意图,我们的系统只对输入进行最小的修改(例如格式校正),因为我们相信,一个世界本来就难以仅用一句或几句来描述,相反,我们把这个意图转移到下一个节点,即创建者。

blocks.en: The Creator. To faithfully yet creatively realize this will, the Creator establishes the rules and sets the tone for the world. Powered by advanced LLMs, the Creator recursively decomposes and refines the idea through a set of agents, each following a structured duty and collaboratively shaping different aspects of the world—such as its visual appearance and operational mechanics.
blocks.zh: 造物师. 为了忠实而创造性地实现这一意愿,造物主为世界制定规则和定下基调。 创造者在先进的LLMs的推动下,通过一套代理人对想法进行再生的分解和完善,每个代理人都要履行结构化的职责,共同塑造世界的不同方面,如视觉外观和操作力学。

blocks.en:
As is well known, many aspects of a world are difficult to infer directly from visual information alone. Examples include underlying rules ( e.g. , traffic regulations), the internal states of agents ( e.g. , health or reputation), and precise physical dynamics governing motion ( e.g. , Newton’s laws). This is a key reason why previous video-generation-based paradigms often fall short in maintaining long-term world consistency and reasoning about such hidden information. Specifically, since these models are trained to directly synthesize pixel-level appearances from data, they lack any explicit mechanism to represent or track such information—information that cannot be readily obtained from visual cues alone.
In contrast, the Creator addresses this challenge by explicitly defining such hidden information—including rules, agent states, and physical dynamics—as part of the world state from the very outset, thereby ensuring that all subsequent generation strictly adheres to these constraints.
In a word, the Creator is the “main brain” of the world.
blocks.zh:
众所周知,一个世界的许多方面很难仅仅从视觉信息中直接推断出来。 例子包括基本规则(例如交通条例)、代理人的内部状态(例如健康或声誉)和关于运动的精确物理动态(例如牛顿的法律)。 这是以往基于视频生成的范式在保持这种隐藏信息的长期世界一致性和推理方面往往达不到的关键原因. 具体地说,由于这些模型受过直接合成数据中的像素级外观的培训,因此它们缺乏任何明确机制来代表或跟踪这类信息——仅从视觉提示中无法轻易获得的信息。
与此相反,创造者从一开始就把这种隐蔽的信息——包括规则、代理状态和物理动态——明确界定为世界国家的一部分,从而确保所有后代严格遵守这些限制。
一句话,造物主是世界的“主要大脑”。

blocks.en: Executors. Once the Creator has established the governing rules, Executors are assigned to complete different parts of the desired world. Driven by advanced multimodal LLMs, Executors act as coding agents that generate executable code to instantiate the whitebox world, i.e. , a 3D blockout representation constructed entirely through code, in strict accordance with the Creator’s blueprint.
blocks.zh: 执行者。 一旦造物主确立了统治规则,就指派执行者完成理想世界的不同部分. 在先进的多式联运LLMs的驱动下,执行者充当编码代理,生成可执行代码以即时化白盒世界,即严格按照创建者的蓝图,完全通过代码构建的3D阻断表示.

blocks.en: Representing the world through executable code, rather than raw pixels, allows the hidden information to be explicitly encoded and enforced, rather than being implicitly and unreliably inferred from visual appearance.
blocks.zh: 通过可执行码来代表世界,而不是原始像素,使得隐藏的信息能够被明确编码和执行,而不是被从视觉外观中隐含和不可靠的推断.

blocks.en:
Artists. The world needs art.
While representing the world through executable code provides precise control over its underlying rules and geometric structure, the resulting whitebox world inevitably lacks visual richness—appearing plain, untextured, and empty. To address this limitation, Artists are introduced to transform the whitebox world into a visually compelling representation, endowing it with a diverse range of visual styles—from photorealistic scenes to anime-inspired aesthetics—all while preserving the structural and logical fidelity established by the Creator and Executors.
blocks.zh:
艺人. 世界需要艺术。
虽然通过可执行代码代表世界为它的基本规则和几何结构提供了精确的控制,但由此产生的白盒世界不可避免地缺乏视觉的丰富性——出现平坦的,没有文字的和空的. 为了解决这一限制,艺术家们被引入了将白盒世界转变为视觉上令人信服的代表,赋予它各种视觉风格——从摄影现实主义的场景到激动人心的美学——所有这一切,同时保持造物者和执行者所建立的结构和逻辑上的忠诚。

blocks.en: Specifically, we tame state-of-the-art video generation models to serve as the Artists within this hierarchically constructed world. An Artist observes a segment of the otherwise drab world and innovatively translates it into a visually appealing, detail-rich video aligned with the Creator’s tone. After generation, the Artist returns the video to the Executors, which register its appearance in the corresponding world region—a mechanism we refer to as Observation as World Registration , which we elaborate on below.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们驯服了最先进的视频生成模型,作为这个分级构建的世界中的艺术家. 一位艺术家观察着原为荒凉世界的一部分, " 艺术家 " 世代相传后,将录像归还给执行者,执行者将录像录入相应的世界区域——我们称之为 " 世界登记观察 " 的机制,下文对此加以阐述。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Method Overview. Left: The pipeline of our CoDeR. The God of Concepts conveys its intent to the Creator. The Creator (LLM) orchestrates the entire world, while the Executors (coding agents) implement the whitebox world. Finally, the Artists (video generation models) render observations along the trajectories sampled by the Travelers. Right: The Observation as World Registration paradigm. Once an observation is generated, it is registered back into the world using its depth map.
blocks.zh: 图2:方法概述。 左边 : 概念之神向造物主传达它的意图。 创造者(LLM)管弦世界,而执行者(编码代理)执行白盒世界. 最后,艺术家(video generation model)沿着旅行者们所采样的轨迹进行观测. 对: 《观察作为世界登记模式》。 观测一旦生成,它就会使用它的深度图重新登记到世界.

blocks.en: Travelers. As the world’s explorers, Travelers visit the world, interact with the environment and other entities, and determine which regions require rendering by the Artists as they explore. In this world system, a Traveler may take the form of a visible entity with a defined appearance, or simply exist as a disembodied camera viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 游历者. 作为世界的探险家,旅行者访问世界,与环境和其他实体互动,并确定哪些地区需要艺术家在探索时进行渲染. 在这个世界体系中,旅行者可能采取一个有明确外观的可见实体的形式,或者简单地作为断裂相机视角存在.

blocks.en: 3.2 World System
blocks.zh: 3.2 世界系统

Each logical space is characterized by a local objective g i g_{i} and an interface contract 𝒦 i \mathcal{K}_{i} , which specifies its inputs, outputs, and construction constraints. These contracts incorporate the shared world rules established by the Creator while leaving space-specific implementation choices to individual Executors. A logical space therefore defines a functional scope rather than necessarily a disjoint spatial region.

blocks.en: Each logical space is assigned to an Executor, i.e. , a coding agent, which constructs its corresponding module: B i = 𝒜 i ( g i , 𝒦 i ) , i = 1 , … , N , B_{i}=\mathcal{A}_{i}(g_{i},\mathcal{K}_{i}),\qquad i=1,\ldots,N, (4) where 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} denotes the construction process performed by the assigned Executor, including code generation, tool execution, and local refinement, and B i B_{i} denotes the resulting module with its scene elements, executable behaviors, and exposed interfaces. Executors can develop modules concurrently once their interface contracts and required dependencies are available. For example, constructing a traffic system involves vehicle design, traffic regulations, and road network layout, making end-to-end development by a single Executor challenging and time-consuming. Decomposition allows these responsibilities to be distributed across multiple Executors.

blocks.en: Observation as World Registration. To preserve a consistent world state each time an Artist paints a segment of the world, we propose the Observation as World Registration paradigm. The core idea is that once an Artist has generated a visual rendering of a segment, this generation is registered back into the world, becoming part of the observation that any subsequent agent perceives when looking at that region.
blocks.zh: 作为世界注册的观察。 为了保持一个连贯的世界状态,每当艺术家描绘出世界的一部分时,我们提议将观察作为世界登记的模式。 核心思想是,一旦一个艺术家产生了一段的视觉渲染,这代人就被重新登记到世界中,成为后来任何代理人在看那个区域时所感知的观察的一部分.

blocks.en: The Artist model in our system is a video generation model, which takes the drab, plain whitebox observation along with its corresponding depth as input, and outputs a visually rich, colorful video. Given an observation chunk with n n frames sampled from the whitebox world, denoted as the video 𝒲 = { w 0 , w 1 , … , w n − 1 } \mathcal{W}=\{w_{0},w_{1},...,w_{n-1}\} , we can readily obtain the corresponding ground-truth depth video 𝒟 = { d 0 , d 1 , … , d n − 1 } \mathcal{D}=\{d_{0},d_{1},...,d_{n-1}\} , as well as semantic information about the sampled location and its surroundings. While not directly discernible from 𝒲 \mathcal{W} itself, it can be directly retrieved from the whitebox world’s underlying state, since the identity and attributes of every entity are already known. We then construct a prompt 𝒫 \mathcal{P} based on this information, such that 𝒱 = Artist ​ ( 𝒲 , 𝒟 , 𝒫 ) \mathcal{V}=\text{Artist}(\mathcal{W},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{P}) , where 𝒱 = { v 0 , v 1 , … , v n − 1 } \mathcal{V}=\{v_{0},v_{1},...,v_{n-1}\} is the resulting generated video.

blocks.en:
To endow the Artist model with the ability to perceive historical context, we introduce a partial registration mechanism. Specifically, given a previously generated video 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and its corresponding ground-truth depth 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , we back-project a randomly sampled subset of 𝒱 \mathcal{V} ’s pixels onto the whitebox world W W and render it from the observation viewpoints, yielding a partially registered observation video ℛ \mathcal{R} —wherein some regions retain their original plain appearance while others have already been colored according to prior generations.
Concretely, the known camera parameters and world geometry allow us to associate the selected pixels with the corresponding surfaces and project their colors into the observation viewpoints. We retain only projections that correspond to the same surface and pass depth-based visibility checks, blending valid observations where they overlap. Denoting these projected colors by Π ⁡ ( 𝒱 , 𝒟 ) \Pi(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{D}) , with zeros at uncovered locations, and their binary coverage mask by ℳ \mathcal{M} , the partial registration is written as: ℛ = ℳ ⊙ Π ⁡ ( 𝒱 , 𝒟 ) + ( 𝟏 − ℳ ) ⊙ 𝒲 , \mathcal{R}=\mathcal{M}\odot\Pi(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{D})+(\mathbf{1}-\mathcal{M})\odot\mathcal{W}, (6) where ⊙ \odot denotes element-wise multiplication and ℳ \mathcal{M} is one in registered regions and zero elsewhere. Thus, previously observed appearance becomes part of the Artist’s next observation, while unobserved regions retain the whitebox appearance for subsequent generation. We then train the Artist model to recover the complete, fully colored video from this partial observation.
blocks.zh:
为了赋予艺术家模式以感知历史背景的能力,我们引入了部分注册机制. 具体地说,给一个先前生成的视频 V\ mathcal{V} 及其相应的地面真实深度 D\ mathcal{D},我们背对一个随机抽样的 V\ mathcal{V} 的像素子集进行投影到白盒世界 WW 上,并从观测角度将其渲染出来,产生部分注册的观测视频 R\mathcal{ R)——在一些地区保留其原有的平面外观,而其他地区则已经按照前几代人来配色.
具体地说,已知的相机参数和世界几何可以让我们将选定的像素与相应的表面联系起来,并将其颜色投射到观测角度. 我们只保留与同一表面相对应的预测,通过深度可见度检查,将重叠的观测结果混合在一起。 将这些预测的颜色由\\\(V,D)\Pi(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{D})标注,在未发现的地方为零,其二进制覆盖罩由M\mathcal{M}标注,部分注册写为: R=M\\\\(V,D)+(1−M)\W,\M\M\M\M\M\M\M\M\M+在注册的地区为1,在其他地方为0。 因此,先前观察到的外观成为艺术家接下来观察的一部分,而未观察到的区域则保留了白盒外观供后人使用. 然后我们训练艺术家模型 从这个部分观察中恢复完整,全色的视频.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Whitebox World Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 " 世界一代 "

blocks.en:
We leverage Three.js as the framework for constructing the code-generated whitebox world, owing to its lightweight, programmable, and composable interface.
This allows Executors to construct independent parts of the world as modular code snippets, which can then be seamlessly linked back together to form the integrated world as described above in Sec. 3.2 .
For human-related scenarios, we adopt SMPL-H ( Romero et al., 2017 ) as the underlying representation to model human motion, hand-object interaction, and viewpoint binding.
blocks.zh:
我们利用Tree.js作为构建代码生成的白盒世界的框架,因为它的轻量级,可编程,可堆肥的界面.
允许 作为模块化代码片段构建世界独立部分的执行者,然后可以无缝连接回一起,形成上面第3.2节描述的综合世界.
对于与人类相关的情景,我们采用SMPL-H(Romero等人,2017年)作为人类运动模型、手物相互作用和观点约束的基本代表。

blocks.en: We implement Creator and Executors using GPT-6 Astra, an advanced multimodal LLM-based coding agent with strong 3D spatial awareness. Leveraging its capabilities in multimodal reasoning and geometric understanding, GPT-6 Astra is able to interpret spatial constraints, reason about object placement and interaction, and generate executable Three.js code that faithfully reflects the intended design.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-6 Astra执行创建器和执行器,这是一个先进的基于LLM的多式联运编码器,具有强大的3D空间意识。 利用其在多式联运推理和几何理解方面的能力,GPT-6 Astra能够解释空间限制,物体定位和相互作用的理由,并生成忠实反映预期设计的可执行的Tree.js代码.

blocks.en: 4.2 Artist Model
blocks.zh: 4.2 艺术家模式

blocks.en: We choose MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , a state-of-the-art open-source video generation model, as our Artist model. Although this video generation model can natively re-render whitebox-like videos into colorful ones, we find that it tends to produce render-style outputs— e.g. , hard edges, monotonous textures, and flat lighting—which undermine the diversity and realism of the generated visuals. In addition, it is difficult to directly adapt this model to our proposed Observation as World Registration paradigm without further tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了MiniMax H3(MiniMax,2026年),一个最先进的开源视频生成模型,作为我们的艺术家模型. 虽然这种视频生成模型可以本土地将白盒般的视频重新放入色彩丰富的视频中,但我们发现它倾向于产生渲染风格的输出——例如硬边,单调纹理,以及平面照明——这破坏了生成的视觉的多样性和现实性. 此外,如果不作进一步调整,很难直接使这一模式适应我们提议的作为世界登记范式的观察。

blocks.en: To address this, we propose a Visual Cue Hacking strategy, which extracts common and reliable visual cues ( e.g. , Canny edges and depth maps) from the whitebox world and leverages them to guide the model taming process.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个Visual Cue Hacking策略,从白盒世界中提取常见和可靠的视觉提示(如坎尼边缘和深度地图),并利用它们来指导模型的驯化过程.

blocks.en: Data Curation. To construct training data using the proposed Visual Cue Hacking strategy, we begin by sampling a random trajectory within the code-generated whitebox world, and extract the corresponding data following the same procedure described in Sec. 3.2 . Following the notation introduced earlier, this yields a whitebox video 𝒲 \mathcal{W} together with its corresponding prompt 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . We then extract Canny edge maps from 𝒲 \mathcal{W} (depth is directly available as 𝒟 \mathcal{D} ), and feed these cues into ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) to generate videos spanning diverse visual styles, denoted as 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . In this way, we obtain training tuples ( 𝒲 \mathcal{W} or ℛ \mathcal{R} , 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , 𝒱 \mathcal{V} ) for our Artist model.
blocks.zh: 数据解析. 为了使用拟议的视觉Cue Hacking策略构建培训数据,我们首先在代码生成的白盒世界中取样随机的轨迹,并按照Sec描述的相同程序提取相应的数据. 3.2 (英语). 在先前引入的标记后, 此选项将生成一个白盒视频 W\ mathcal{ W} 及其相应的 prote P\ mathcal{ P} 。 然后我们从 W\ mathcal{W} 中提取 Canny 边缘地图( 深度直接作为 D\ mathcal{D} ) , 把这些提示输入 ControlNet (Zhang et al., 2023) , 生成跨越多种视觉风格的视频, 表示为 V\ mathcal{V} 。 这样,我们就能为我们的艺人模型获得训练Tuples(W\mathcal{W}或R\mathcal{R},D\mathcal{D},P\mathcal{P},V\mathcal{V}.

blocks.en: Training. We train our Artist model using 32 NVIDIA A800 GPUs, with a global batch size of 16 for 200 training steps. We adopt AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) as the optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Each video clip is resized to a resolution of 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 and temporally sampled to contain 124 frames. During training, the transformer backbone is fine-tuned using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) while the ControlNet branch undergoes full-parameter fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们使用32个NVIDIA A800 GPU来训练我们的艺术家模型,全球批量大小为16个,用于200个训练步骤. 我们采用AdamW(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年)作为优化者,学习率为1×10−5 1\Times 10×5}。 每个视频片段的大小调整为分辨率为1280×704 1280\times 704,时间采样后包含124帧. 在训练期间,变压器骨干采用LORA(Hu等人,2022年)进行微调,而控制网分支进行全参数微调.

blocks.en: Figure 3: We sample a rotational trajectory to examine whether the “Coding World System” mark is consistently maintained on the wall. The results show that ABot-World exhibits severe quality degradation, while Matrix-Game 3.0 fails to preserve the mark. LingBot-World fails to accurately respond to the control signals, resulting in duplicated frames. In contrast, our method successfully follows the rotational trajectory while consistently preserving the mark on the wall.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们取样了一个旋转轨迹,以审查墙上是否始终保持“编码世界系统”标记。 结果显示,ABot-World显示质量严重退化,而Matrix-Game 3.0则未能保存标记. 灵灵 Bot-World未能准确响应控制信号,导致帧重复. 相比之下,我们的方法成功地遵循了旋转轨道,同时始终保持了墙上的标记。

blocks.en: 4.3 Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.3 定性比较

blocks.en: In this section, we demonstrate that our CoDeR exhibits several key properties that a reliable world should possess, including memory, open-ended interactivity, and continuous evolution, and further explore its capabilities in multi-agent scenarios ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Savva et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们表明,我们的CoDER显示了一个可靠的世界应当拥有的几个关键特性,包括记忆、开放式互动和持续演变,并进一步探索其在多剂情况下的能力(Wu等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年a; Hu等人, 2026b; Savva等人, 2026).

blocks.en: Memory. Although our Artist model is trained with a fixed context length of 124 frames, we observe strong long-term memory capabilities enabled by our proposed Observation as World Registration strategy. We evaluate a 360-degree rotation to examine whether the tested methods can preserve the scene structure and the “Coding World System” mark over a long temporal horizon. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , ABot-World ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) exhibits severe quality degradation, while Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026e ) loses the building structure, and LingBot-World ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) fails to accurately follow the input trajectory. In contrast, our method achieves a closed-loop rollout while preserving both geometric and appearance consistency.
blocks.zh: 记忆. 虽然我们的艺术家模型接受了固定上下文长度为124帧的培训,但我们观察到我们提议的观察作为世界登记战略所赋予的强大的长期记忆能力。 我们评价360度的旋转,以检查所测试的方法是否能够在较长的时间范围内保留场景结构和“编码世界系统”标志。 如图3所示,ABot-World(Jiang等人,2026年)显示质量严重退化,Matrix-Game 3.0(Wang等人,2026e)则失去建筑结构,LingBot-World(Robbyant Team等人,2026年)未能准确遵循输入轨迹. 相比之下,我们的方法在保持几何和外观一致性的同时实现了闭路展开。

blocks.en: Open-ended Interactions. We enable open-ended world interactions, ranging from opening a door to piloting a spaceship, by leveraging powerful code-defined interaction logic. Rather than relying on a predefined action space, our CoDeR allows the Creator to define new actions, which are subsequently implemented by the Executors, making the action space continuously extensible. As shown in Fig. 4 , the left part of the figure demonstrates diverse code-defined actions in the whitebox world together with their corresponding visual realizations by the Artists. Experiments further show that conventional methods with predefined interactions tend to fail on challenging environment-level interactions, such as opening doors. As illustrated on the right side of Fig. 4 , EgoSim ( Hao et al., 2026 ) is unable to open the door. In contrast, our method successfully opens the door and reveals the new environment behind it.
blocks.zh: 开放式互动。 我们通过利用强大的密码定义互动逻辑,实现开放的世界互动,从打开大门到试飞太空船。 我们的CoDER没有依赖预先定义的动作空间,而是允许创建者定义新的动作,这些动作随后由执行者执行,使得动作空间可以持续扩展. 如图4所示,图中的左侧部分展示了白盒世界中不同的代码定义动作,以及艺术家们相应的视觉实现. 实验进一步表明,具有预先定义的相互作用的常规方法往往在挑战性的环境层面相互作用上失败,例如打开大门. 如图4右侧所示,EgoSim(Hao等人,2026年)无法开门。 相反,我们的方法成功地打开了大门,揭示了它背后的新环境。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Left: We support open-ended interactions ranging from playing the piano to riding a dragon. Right: Comparison with EgoSim, which fails to open the door, while our method successfully opens it and reveals the new environment.
blocks.zh: 图4:左边: 我们支持从弹钢琴到骑龙的开放式互动。 右:与未能打开门的EgoSim比较,同时我们的方法成功打开并揭示了新的环境.

blocks.en: Figure 5: We demonstrate the world evolution mechanism of our method in comparison with other approaches. In the first frame, a tap is pouring water into a glass cup. The camera then moves away from the cup and later returns to examine whether the water level has continued to rise. HyDRA produces a static water column, while LiveWorld exhibits obvious visual artifacts. In contrast, our method continuously updates the water level even when the cup is out of sight.
blocks.zh: 图5:与其他方法相比,我们展示了我们方法的世界演变机制。 在第一个画框中,一个水龙头将水倒进玻璃杯中. 相机随后离开杯子,随后返回检查水位是否继续上升. HyDRA生产一个静水柱,而LiveWorld则展出明显的视觉文物. 相比之下,我们的方法不断更新水位,即使杯子不在眼前。

blocks.en: Evolution. Our CoDeR effectively models event evolution, an essential capability for maintaining persistent dynamics in world models. We evaluate this capability against existing methods in Fig. 5 . The results show that HyDRA ( Chen et al., 2026b ) fails to model the continuous water-pouring process, as the water column remains nearly static across frames. LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) captures some water dynamics but exhibits obvious visual artifacts and fails to correctly update the water level in the cup after it moves out of sight. In contrast, our method accurately captures the water dynamics and continuously updates the underlying state even when the cup is outside the field of view, correctly reflecting the increased water level when it becomes visible again.
blocks.zh: 进化 我们的CoDER有效模拟事件演进,是维持世界模型中持续动态的基本能力. 我们对照图5中的现有方法评估这种能力。 结果表明,HyDRA(Chen等人,2026年b)未能模拟连续的探水过程,因为水柱在跨框架上仍然几乎静止。 LiveWorld(Duan等人,2026年)捕捉到一些水动力,但展出明显的视觉文物,未能在杯子离开视线后正确更新水位. 相比之下,我们的方法准确地捕捉了水的动力学,并不断更新基本状态,即使杯子在视野之外,也正确地反映了水位在再次显眼时的提升.

blocks.en: Multi-agent Scenarios. We additionally explore multi-Traveler (multi-agent) scenarios ( Zhao et al., 2026b ; Hu et al., 2026a ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) and find that, with our proposed Observation as World Registration paradigm, the actions of one Traveler can modify the shared environment, while the resulting changes are simultaneously reflected in the observations of other agents. As shown in Fig. 6 , when Agent 1 takes down a target, the event is observed by Agent 2. Likewise, when Agent 2 moves forward and takes down another target, the event is also observed by Agent 1. These results demonstrate the potential of our CoDeR as a promising framework for multi-agent world modeling.
blocks.zh: 多剂假想. 此外,我们还探索多旅行者(多代理人)方案(赵等人,2026年b; 胡等人,2026a; Mo et al., 2026; Liu et al., 2026),并发现,以我们提议的观察作为世界登记范式,一个旅行者的行动可以改变共享的环境,而由此产生的变化同时反映在其他代理者的观察中. 如图6所示,当Agent 1击落目标时,事件由Agent观察. 2. 国家 同样,当Agent 2前进并击落另一个目标时,事件也被Agent 1观察到. 这些成果表明,我们的合作社发展伙伴关系具有潜力,可以成为多代理世界模式化的有希望的框架。

blocks.en: Figure 6: We further explore multi-agent scenarios in our system. When Agent 1 takes down a target, the event is simultaneously observed by Agent 2. Likewise, when Agent 2 moves forward and shoots another target, the event is also observed by Agent 1.
blocks.zh: 图6:我们进一步探索本系统中的多代理方案。 当Agent 1击落目标时,Agent同时观察事件 2. 国家 同样,当Agent 2前进并射击另一个目标时,事件也被Agent 1观察到.

blocks.zh: 4.4 数量比较

The results are shown in Tab. 1 , where our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics compared with the other approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们与ABot-World、LingBot-World和Matrix-Game 3.0进行定量比较,对世界得分基准(Duan等人,2025年)的10个指标进行定量比较。 其结果在Tab.1中显示,与其他方法相比,我们的方法在所有指标上都取得了最新业绩。

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative Comparison. Our method outperforms all competing methods across all metrics.
blocks.zh: 表1:定量比较。 我们的方法超越了所有衡量标准上的所有相互竞争的方法。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on our Visual Cue Hacking strategy and Observation as World Registration paradigm using three metrics from WorldScore ( Duan et al., 2025 ) and four metrics from VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) to evaluate their contributions to visual quality. As shown in Tab. 2 , removing either Visual Cue Hacking or Observation as World Registration leads to degraded visual quality compared with the full model.

blocks.zh: 表2:阅读研究。 作为世界注册的视觉Cue Hacking和观测都有助于提高世界分数和V Bench 度量衡的视觉质量。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced CoDeR , a new paradigm for world modeling that separates the underlying world from its visual realization. Instead of relying on video models to implicitly encode world dynamics, our framework constructs persistent and executable worlds through collaborative coding agents, while employing generative models to render perceptual observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this design not only broadens the capabilities of current world models, but also achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse settings. More broadly, we hope this work encourages a shift from modeling worlds as sequences of observations toward constructing worlds as persistent computational systems that can be created, experienced, and continuously evolved.
And finally, every Traveler is, in essence, the God of Concepts.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了CoDER,这是世界建模的新范式,它将基础世界与视觉实现区分开来. 我们的框架不是依赖视频模型来暗含地编码世界动态,而是通过协作编码剂构建持久和可执行的世界,同时使用基因模型来进行感知观察. 广泛的实验表明,这种设计不仅拓宽了目前世界模型的能力,而且实现了不同环境的最先进的性能. 更广泛地说,我们希望这项工作鼓励从模拟世界作为观察序列向构建世界作为持续计算系统转变,这种系统可以创造、经验和不断演变。
最后,每个 旅行者本质上是概念之神.

blocks.en: User Study
blocks.zh: 用户研究

blocks.en: To further evaluate our proposed CoDeR, we conduct a user study comparing it with Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026e ) , LingBot-World ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) , EgoSim ( Hao et al., 2026 ) , and LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) across the following dimensions: Visual Quality, Interaction Consistency, Memory & Persistence, World Evolution, and Overall Preference. Each participant is asked to score the videos generated by different methods along each dimension. As shown in Fig. 7 , we collect 30 valid questionnaires, and the results show that our method consistently outperforms the competing approaches across all evaluated dimensions.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价我们提议的CoDER,我们进行了用户研究,将其与Matrix-Game 3.0(Wang等人,2026e)进行比较。 Bot-World(Robbyant Team等人,2026年),EgoSim公司 (Hao等人,2026年),和LiveWorld(Duan等人,2026年)跨越以下维度:视觉质量,相互作用一致性,记忆与持久性,世界进化,以及总体偏好. 要求每个参与者按照每个维度对不同方法生成的视频进行评分. 如图7所示,我们收集了30份有效的问卷,调查结果显示,我们的方法一贯优于所有评价层面的相互竞争的方法。

blocks.en: Figure 7: User Study. Human evaluation across Visual Quality, Interaction Consistency, Memory and Persistence, World Evolution, and Overall Preference. Our method consistently achieves the highest scores across all evaluated dimensions.
blocks.zh: 图7:用户研究。 跨越视觉质量,互动一致性,记忆与持久性,世界进化,以及总体偏好等的人类评价. 我们的方法在所有评价的层面都取得了最高的分数。

blocks.en: Visual Cue Hacking
blocks.zh: 视觉 Cue 黑客

blocks.en: We further illustrate the effect of our Visual Cue Hacking strategy in Fig. 8 . We compare videos generated by directly conditioning on the whitebox renderings with those produced using Visual Cue Hacking. As shown in Fig. 8 , directly rendering from whitebox videos tends to produce visually monotonous, render-like results with overly sharp and rigid edges, as the generation model closely follows the low-level geometry of the white-box inputs. In contrast, Visual Cue Hacking effectively adapts the model to the whitebox domain while preventing it from overfitting to these artificial boundaries. As a result, the model treats the whitebox video primarily as a structural cue rather than a pixel-level rendering target, enabling substantially higher visual quality with richer appearance and more natural details.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步说明了我们在图8的视觉Cue Hacking战略的效果。 我们比较了由白盒渲染器上的直接调制产生的视频与使用Visual Cue Hacking制作的视频. 如图8所示,从白盒视频直接渲染往往产生视觉单调,渲染效果类似,边缘过于尖锐和僵硬,因为生成模型紧密地跟随白盒输入的低等几何. 相比之下,Visual Cue Hacking有效地使模型适应了白盒域,同时防止它过度适应这些人工边界. 因此,该模型主要将白盒视频视为结构提示而非像素级渲染目标,使得视觉质量显著提高,外观更丰富,细节更自然.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Effect of Visual Cue Hacking. Directly conditioning on whitebox renderings produces monotonous, render-like videos with rigid edges, whereas our Visual Cue Hacking strategy encourages the model to use the whitebox input as a structural cue, resulting in richer appearance and higher visual quality.
blocks.zh: 图8:视觉Cue Hacking的效果。 直接对白盒渲染的调制产生单调,渲染般的带刚性边缘的视频,而我们的Visual Cue Hacking策略则鼓励模型将白盒输入作为结构提示,导致更丰富的外观和更高的视觉质量.

blocks.en: Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 评价细节

blocks.en: Since our method cannot be directly adapted to the input formats of many existing benchmarks, we first construct a corresponding whitebox world from the benchmark inputs and then sample videos within this reconstructed environment for evaluation. Specifically, given a first frame, we first use SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) to segment the scene into its constituent objects and employ Depth Anything V2 ( Yang et al., 2024a ) to estimate the corresponding depth map. We then feed the first frame, segmentation map, and depth map into GPT-6 Astra to construct the whitebox world, as illustrated in Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh: 由于我们的方法不能直接适应许多现有基准的输入格式,因此我们首先从基准输入构建一个相应的白盒世界,然后在这个重建的环境下对视频进行抽样评估. 具体地说,给第一个框架,我们首先使用SAM 3(Carion等人,2026年)将场景分割到其组成物体中,并使用深度Anything V2(Yang等人,2024a年)来估计相应的深度图. 然后,我们将第一个框架、分区图和深度图输入GPT-6 Astra,以构建白盒世界,如图9所示。

blocks.en: Note that the reconstructed whitebox world is not required to be perfectly aligned with the first frame. In practice, discrepancies may arise in object geometry, shape, or fine-grained scene structure. Nevertheless, we find that conditioning the generation model on the original first frame effectively anchors the visual content to the reconstructed world. Even when the geometry of an object is only approximately matched, the generated appearance can still be aligned with its corresponding location in the whitebox world, allowing the reconstructed environment to serve as a reliable structural scaffold for benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 注意重建后的白盒世界不需要与第一帧完全对齐. 在实践中,在物体几何,形状,或细纹的场景结构上可能出现差异. 尽管如此,我们发现,在最初的第一帧上对生成模型进行调制,有效地将视觉内容固定在重建的世界中. 即使一个物体的几何图案只是大致匹配,生成的外观仍然可以与其在白盒世界中的相应位置对齐,使重建的环境能够作为基准评价的可靠的结构脚手架.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Given the first frame, we obtain its segmentation map and depth map, and then reconstruct a corresponding whitebox world.
blocks.zh: 图9:鉴于第一个框架,我们获得它的分区图和深度图,然后重建相应的白盒世界.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Extreme-Long Video Generation. Our current Artist model is fine-tuned with a fixed temporal window of 124 frames and does not undergo additional post-training specifically designed for long-horizon video generation. To generate longer sequences, we adopt a chunk-based generation strategy and concatenate multiple clips autoregressively. As a result, visual errors and distribution shifts can gradually accumulate over time, inevitably leading to quality degradation in extremely long rollouts. As shown in Fig. 10 , at approximately 5,000 frames, noticeable degradation appears in the generated video. We believe that incorporating dedicated long-video post-training or more effective temporal memory mechanisms could further improve long-horizon generation quality.
blocks.zh: 极长影视世代. 我们目前的艺人模式通过124帧的固定时间窗口进行微调,不经过专门为长视视频生成而设计的附加后训练. 为了生成更长的序列,我们采用了基于块的生成策略,并自动地将多个片段缩合. 因此,视觉误差和分布转移会逐渐积累,在极长的推广过程中不可避免地导致质量退化. 如图10所示,在制作的视频中,大约5 000帧明显退化。 我们认为,纳入专门的长视频培训后或更有效的时间记忆机制,可进一步提高长视距生成质量。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Limitation of Long-Horizon Video Generation. Our Artist model is trained with a fixed 124-frame window and generates long videos through chunk-based rollout. Noticeable visual degradation emerges due to accumulated generation errors.
blocks.zh: 图10:长视视频生成的限制. 我们的艺术家模型通过固定的124帧窗口进行训练,并通过块式推出生成长视频. 由于累积的生成错误,出现了明显的视觉退化.

blocks.en: Whitebox Modeling. Our framework also inherits limitations from the construction and simulation of the whitebox world. In particular, accurately modeling complex hand-object interactions remains challenging, where the reconstructed or simulated hand poses may exhibit severe geometric distortion. In addition, imperfect scene geometry or collision handling can occasionally result in 3D interpenetration between objects. Representative failure cases are shown in Fig. 11 . These limitations suggest that more accurate geometry reconstruction, articulated object modeling, and physically grounded interaction simulation could further improve the fidelity of the underlying world representation.
blocks.zh: 白箱建模. 我们的框架也继承了白盒世界的构建和模拟的局限性. 特别是,精确地模拟复杂的手物体相互作用仍然具有挑战性,在那里,重建或模拟的手可能表现出严重的几何扭曲。 此外,不完善的场景几何或碰撞处理偶尔会导致物体之间的3D穿透. 代表性故障案件见图11。 这些限制表明,更准确的几何重建、清晰的物体模型制作以及实体化的相互作用模拟,可以进一步提高基本世界代表性的忠诚度。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Limitations of Whitebox Modeling. Our current whitebox world may exhibit failure cases in complex hand-object interactions and 3D geometry, including severely distorted hand poses and object interpenetration.
blocks.zh: 图11:白盒建模的局限性. 我们目前的白盒世界可能在复杂的手物体相互作用和三维几何中出现故障,包括严重扭曲的手姿和物体间穿插.

blocks.en: Future work
blocks.zh: 今后的工作

blocks.en: Beyond improving long-horizon video generation as discussed above, an important direction for future work is to further disentangle the visual generation process of the Artist model. Our current Artist directly generates complete RGB observations, in which geometry, material properties, illumination, and appearance are implicitly entangled. To better align with the paradigm proposed in this work, future Artist models could instead generate decomposed visual representations, such as Albedo, Normal, Roughness, and Irradiance maps, following recent progress in material- and lighting-aware image decomposition and synthesis ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) . As illustrated in Fig. 12 , such factorized representations could provide more explicit and reusable scene information, making generated observations easier to register, update, and re-render within the underlying world. We believe this direction could further strengthen our Observation as World Registration paradigm by turning observations from monolithic RGB frames into structured visual states that can be more faithfully integrated back into the world.
blocks.zh: 除了上文讨论过的改进长视距视频生成,未来工作的一个重要方向是进一步分散艺术家模型的视觉生成过程. 我们目前的艺术家直接生成完整的RGB观测,其中几何,物质属性,照明,和外观被含蓄地缠绕在一起. 为了更好地与本作品中提议的范式保持一致,未来的艺术家模型可以产生分解的视觉表现,如Albedo、Normal、Ruffness和Irandance地图,同时注意最近在材料和照明感知图像分解和合成方面取得的进展(Zeng等人,2024年)。 如图12所示,这种因地制宜的表述可以提供更明确和可重复使用的场景信息,使生成的观测数据更容易在基础世界中登记、更新和重新提交。 我们认为,这个方向可以进一步加强我们作为世界登记范式的观察,将观测从单一的RGB框架转变为结构化的视觉状态,可以更忠实地融入世界。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Towards Disentangled Visual Generation. Future Artist models could decompose RGB observations into structured visual representations, including Albedo, Normal, Roughness, and Irradiance, enabling more explicit scene registration, editing, and re-rendering within the CoDeR.
blocks.zh: 图12:向分散视觉一代迈进。 未来的艺术家模型可以将 RGB 观测分解成结构化的视觉表现,包括Albedo, Normal, Roughness, 和Irandance, 从而可以在 CoDeR 内更明确地进行场景登记,编辑,并重新交代.
